summary: Careful, well-documented preregistered paired experiment testing constrained prompting + verifier-guided single-repair vs unconstrained baseline on a synthetic intent→configuration corpus. Execution artifacts and analysis are complete and internally consistent; main finding is a null/practically negligible paired improvement (149/150 → 150/150) with a ceiling effect. Reproducibility evidence and preregistration fidelity are strong. Manuscript is publishable after three targeted, resolvable manuscript clarifications.
critical_issues: Disclosure Statement in the current manuscript duplicates run-internal provenance (paths and full hashes) in the main text rather than providing a concise disclosure and referencing the archived execution manifest/supplementary artifact bundle; this conflicts with the track guidance to keep provenance-heavy bookkeeping out of ordinary prose.

The manuscript must more explicitly and prominently distinguish (in Methods and Results) initial single-shot candidate validity from final guarded-pipeline validity given the preregistered shared_initial_candidate semantics. Although the run log records that the same initial generation was reused and only one guarded repair call occurred, the paper's current phrasing does not unambiguously label baseline = initial-candidate outcome and guarded = final-pipeline outcome for every reader.

The manuscript must explicitly confirm IEEE-style numbered in-text citation usage and ensure no raw DOI/URL identifiers appear inline where bracketed citation markers are required. (Referenced records appear verified, but the paper must meet the track's citation-format requirement in the main text.)
required_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement in the main manuscript to a concise statement that lists models, validator, adapter family, that the preregistration was frozen (include SHA-256), the autonomy boundary, and where full provenance and full hash manifest are archived (cite the execution_manifest.json or supplement). Move run-internal paths and full artifact hashes out of the main prose into the supplementary artifact bundle and cite that bundle from the Disclosure Statement.

Add an explicit, unambiguous sentence in Methods and in Results clarifying shared_initial_candidate semantics: state that the same initial model generation was used for baseline and guarded for each pair, that baseline success counts refer to that initial candidate's verifier pass/fail, and that guarded success counts reflect the final (post-repair if invoked) outcome; include the exact repair-stage invocation count (1/150) next to the contingency table and in the Results text.

Ensure the manuscript uses IEEE numbered in-text citations (e.g., [1], [2]) everywhere and remove any inline raw DOI/URL identifiers from running prose. If any reference in the bibliography is used to support a proximate factual claim, add a one-line page/section justification in the reference-verification supplement confirming that the cited record supports that claim (the execution bundle already contains verified records; link this confirmation in the manuscript).
optional_revisions: Add one brief sentence in Results noting that the exact-McNemar p-value degeneracy (discordant n=1) limits inferential power here and that the bootstrap CI and the observed ceiling effect are the more informative diagnostics for this dataset.

In Discussion, briefly note that alternative generation semantics (independent initial samples per condition) or larger repair budgets could produce different outcomes and that these are natural future-work directions (no new experiments requested).
